entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about an order. I... I'm just so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for years and I was really looking forward to my new gear.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's the Pro-Cycle jersey I bought. I tried it on, and it's just the wrong size. It feels way too tight, and I can't ride comfortably in it at all. I really needed the money for other things, and now I have this jersey I can't even use.

I understand how frustrating that must be, especially when you're excited about a new jersey. Getting the fit right is essential. Let me just pull up your account information. I can see the order here, delivered 14 days ago.
Yes, that's the one. I was hoping I could maybe get an exchange, but honestly, at this point, I'd rather just return it if that's possible. I feel so bad about this.

Please don't feel bad at all, these things happen. Let me just check our return policy for you... Okay, good news. I can see here that the jersey is a standard item, and it's eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, really? So I can return it for a full refund?

Absolutely. Since it's only been 14 days, you're well within that window. I've just initiated the return process for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Just pack the item back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
Oh, wow. That is such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
